name: agent-face
title: Agent Face
description: An agent's face: one of 18 preset characters in one of 9 palettes, the Pebble from 40px and the Dot below, showing nine states with CSS-only motion and a still pose under reduced motion.

meta.whenToUse: An agent's face on its own: a face picker, an agent's header, an onboarding moment. Avatars in rows and stacks use PersonAvatar, which draws it.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person, team or workspace (PersonAvatar); a loader (Spinner, TextSpinner).
